newsitem.title: POLAND: DEUTSCHE BANK TO EXPAND IN POLAND.
newsitem.headline: DEUTSCHE BANK TO EXPAND IN POLAND.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG, operating in Poland since 1995 with an subsidiary in Warsaw, plans to open branches in four big Polish cities, a member of the bank's management board said on Thursday.

Georg Krupp said that Deutsche's Polish unit, which services about one third of trade transactions between Poland and Germany, would open branches in the cities of Gdansk, Krakow, Poznan and Katowice.
"The Gdansk branch will be opened in the autumn this year," Krupp told Reuters.
Krupp highly praised the country's free market reforms and said Poland was best prepared for joining the European Union out of all former Soviet bloc countries.
